name: atlas
description: Offline-first mapping and navigation platform (OsmAnd-inspired) for Android + Web.

scripts._comment:build:packages: Hand-ordered dependency waves — npm does not topologically sort -w. EVERY new package must be added here, in a wave after the packages it imports, or it is simply never built: the tree keeps working locally on a stale dist/ while a clean build (the Docker quality gate) fails.
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @atlas/core -w @atlas/conditions && npm run build -w @atlas/gpx -w @atlas/storage -w @atlas/transit && npm run build -w @atlas/routing -w @atlas/sync && npm run build -w @atlas/navigation -w @atlas/app-hooks
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @atlas/backend && npm run build -w @atlas/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
